name: Darren M. Tobin
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Atlanta, Georgia
education: University of Georgia School of Law
about: Darren Tobin focuses his practice exclusively on personal injury and wrongful death litigation. Based in Atlanta, Georgia, he provides representation to clients throughout the state of Georgia.

Mr. Tobin represents individuals and families who have suffered loss because of someone or something's negligence. The types of cases that he has handled during his career include truck and motor vehicle crashes, auto-pedestrian accidents, nursing home neglect, premises liability, and sexual assault. During his career, Mr. Tobin has been able to obtain significant compensation for his clients through both jury verdicts and large negotiated settlements.

In August 2022, he won a $100,000,000.00 verdict in federal court after a two-week trial. That same year, he resolved a serious injury case for $5,200,000.00 which set the record for the largest settlement in this conservative Georgia.
In 2023 he negotiated before trial a wrongful death settlement of $22,700,000.00 in a tractor-trailer collision case.

In 2024, he won two seven figure verdicts— $2,000,000.00 for a premises case, and $1,600,000.00 for a bicycle on bicycle accident which set the record. In both jury trials the medical bills were less than $160,000.

His successful track record of winning big cases, has led to a great deal of recognition from his colleagues, including an AV Preeminent* peer-review rating through Martindale-Hubbell, an AV Preeminent* judicial-review rating through Martindale-Hubbell, a 10.0 "Superb" peer-review rating through Avvo, and 10 out 10 from Georgia Trend Legal. In addition, Mr. Tobin has been named to both The National Trial Lawyers: Top 40 Under 40 and The National Trial Lawyers: Top 100, and he has been selected for inclusion in The Best Lawyers in America.

Mr. Tobin attended the University of Georgia on an academic scholarship, and he tutored several members of the school's football team before graduating with a double major magna cum laude in 2005. He chose to stay at the University of Georgia School of Law and participated in Moot Court competitions before he graduated in 2008.
He loves his job, his family, and fighting for his clients. He has built his law firm by hiring talented, compassionate, and very hard-working lawyers and staff.

*AV®, AV Preeminent®, Martindale-Hubbell Distinguished and Martindale-Hubbell Notable are certification marks used under license in accordance with the Martindale-Hubbell certification procedures, standards and policies. Martindale-Hubbell® is the facilitator of a peer review rating process. Ratings reflect the anonymous opinions of members of the bar and the judiciary. Martindale-Hubbell® Peer Review Rating™ fall into two categories – legal ability and general ethical standards.
